issues.title: [Project] Open grid-connection queue tracker
issues.body:
### Problem

11-clean-electricity

### Sub-goal

grids

### Step

t10424

### What will it do?

Collect every public interconnection queue into one open dataset, updated weekly, so developers and regulators can see where projects are stuck.

Starts with the US ISOs, then the EU TSOs.

### Why it matters

Over 2,000 GW of clean capacity is waiting in queues. See https://emp.lbl.gov/queues

### Stage

Active

### Looking for

- Data engineer
- Someone who knows ENTSO-E data
- Pilot regulator

### Links

https://github.com/example/queues
